name: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% (30ml)
subtitle: High-strength vitamin and mineral blemish formula for glowing, balanced skin texture.
description: The Ordinary Niacinamide 10% + Zinc 1% is a water-based serum that boosts skin brightness, improves skin smoothness, and reinforces the skin barrier over time. Formulated with a high concentration of niacinamide (vitamin B3) supported by zinc PCA to balance visible sebum activity.

name: CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion (237ml)
subtitle: Lightweight, oil-free moisturizer with 3 essential ceramides and hyaluronic acid.
description: Developed with dermatologists, CeraVe Daily Moisturizing Lotion has a unique, lightweight formula that provides 24-hour hydration and helps restore the protective skin barrier with three essential ceramides (1, 3, 6-II). Utilizes patented MVE delivery technology.

name: COSRX Advanced Snail 96 Mucin Power Essence (100ml)
subtitle: Lightweight hydrating essence enriched with 96.3% snail secretion filtrate.
description: Formulated with 96.3% Snail Secretion Filtrate, this essence protects the skin from moisture loss while improving skin elasticity. Snail mucin helps repair and soothes red, sensitized skin post-breakouts by replenishing moisture.

name: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVmune 400 SPF50+ (50ml)
subtitle: Ultra-long UVA protection, invisible fluid finish with sweat & water resistance.
description: La Roche-Posay Anthelios UVmune 400 Invisible Fluid SPF50+ offers the ultimate broad-spectrum protection against UVA and UVB rays, specially designed for sensitive skin in tropical climates.

name: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Generation) MagSafe Case
subtitle: Up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation, Adaptive Audio, and USB-C MagSafe charging.
description: AirPods Pro (2nd generation) with USB-C delivers up to 2x more Active Noise Cancellation than the previous generation, with Transparency mode that lets you hear the world around you, and all-new Adaptive Audio that dynamically tailors noise control to your environment.
ingredients: Personalized Spatial Audio with Dynamic Head Tracking
IP54 Dust, Sweat, and Water Resistant

name: Samsung Galaxy Watch 6 Bluetooth (44mm)
subtitle: Super AMOLED Sapphire Crystal display, advanced sleep coaching and ECG heart monitor.
description: Start your everyday wellness journey with Samsung Galaxy Watch 6. Featuring a 20% larger screen and a 30% slimmer bezel, complete with personalized HR zones, comprehensive sleep analysis, and fast wireless charging.

name: Anker 20,000mAh 22.5W High-Speed Power Bank
subtitle: Triple-port fast charging power bank with digital battery indicator display.
description: Equipped with 22.5W PowerIQ and Power Delivery fast-charging technology. Charge 3 devices simultaneously with 2 USB-A and 1 USB-C ports. Built-in MultiProtect safety system protects your devices from overcurrent and short circuits.
ingredients: 22.5W Max Fast Charging via USB-C PD

name: Sony WH-1000XM5 Wireless ANC Headphones
subtitle: Industry-leading noise cancellation with two processors and 8 microphones.
description: Sony's flagship WH-1000XM5 headphones rewrite the rules for distraction-free listening. With 2 processors controlling 8 microphones, Auto NC Optimizer, and an ultra-comfortable lightweight design in soft fit leather.
ingredients: Integrated Processor V1 & HD Noise Cancelling QN1

name: Dior Sauvage Eau De Parfum (100ml)
subtitle: Iconic fresh and woody composition with Calabrian bergamot and Papua New Guinean vanilla.
description: A powerful and noble fragrance, Dior Sauvage Eau de Parfum unfurls an olfactory score that oscillates between raw freshness and sensual, mysterious warmth. Accents of smoked vanilla absolute enveloped in amber notes create an unmistakable signature.
ingredients: Heart Notes: Virginian Cedar, Sri Lankan Sandalwood
Base Notes: Papua New Guinean Vanilla Absolute

name: Chanel Bleu De Chanel Pour Homme EDP (100ml)
subtitle: An aromatic, intensely woody fragrance for the man who defies convention.
description: BLEU DE CHANEL Eau de Parfum is an aromatic-woody fragrance with ambery and musky notes. A sensual interpretation in which dry cedar notes lend sensual warmth, while New Caledonian sandalwood brings elegance and depth.
ingredients: Top Notes: Grapefruit, Lemon, Mint, Pink Pepper
Heart Notes: Ginger, Nutmeg, Jasmine, Iso E Super
Base Notes: Incense, Vetiver, Cedar, Sandalwood

name: Al Haramain Amber Oud Gold Edition (60ml)
subtitle: Opulent fruity oriental unisex fragrance with sweet melon, pineapple, and warm vanilla amber.
description: Amber Oud Gold Edition is a luxurious oriental fragrance that captures elegance with sweet, sparkling top notes followed by rich amber and sensual musk. Extraordinary longevity and sillage suitable for both daily wear and special occasions.
ingredients: Heart Notes: Sweet Melon, Pineapple, Amber
Base Notes: Vanilla, Musk, Woody Accord

name: Bella Vita Luxury Organic Unisex Perfume Set (4x20ml)
subtitle: Gift pack featuring CEO, White Oud, Skai Aquatic, and Fresh luxury travel editions.
description: A curated discovery set of premium artisanal EDP perfumes. Perfect for personal gifting and travel, delivering all-day fragrance variety from fresh aquatic morning notes to royal white oud evening sophistication.

subtitle: Handcrafted pure silk-blend panjabi with intricate zardosi collar embroidery.

subtitle: Dense, ultra-soft combed Supima cotton with ribbed collar and pre-shrunk finish.
description: Constructed with premium 220 GSM long-staple combed cotton for substantial drape and non-translucent durability. Features double-needle coverstitched hems and reactive color dyeing that withstands dozens of washes.

name: Handloom Floral Georgette Party Saree
subtitle: Flowing lightweight pure georgette saree with digital floral prints and scalloped zari border.
description: An ethereal blend of traditional Bangladeshi handloom weaving and contemporary pastel floral aesthetics. Light as air and effortlessly drapeable, accompanied by an unstitched contrast designer blouse piece.

name: Executive Crisp Slim Fit Oxford Cotton Shirt
subtitle: Wrinkle-resistant 100% Egyptian long-staple cotton shirt tailored for executive sharpness.
description: Designed with precision collar fusing, genuine horn buttons, and breathable fine basketweave Oxford texture. Engineered to stay crisp and comfortable through 12-hour workdays in Bangladesh's weather.

name: Pampers Premium Protection Diaper Pants (Size 4 Mega)
subtitle: Feather-like softness with 360° breathable waistband and up to 12hr leak-lock protection.

ingredients: No More Tears Tearless Cleansing Base
pH Balanced with Coconut Oil Extract

name: Ultrasonic Aroma Essential Oil Diffuser (500ml)
subtitle: 7-color ambient LED nightlight, whisper-quiet misting with auto shut-off safety.
